instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in your right hand.
2. Bend your knees slightly and lean your torso forward, placing your left hand on your left knee for support.
3. Let your right arm hang straight down.
4. Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder, keeping your upper arm still.
5. Squeeze your biceps at the top, then lower under control.
6. Repeat, then switch arms.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arm fixed to isolate the biceps.
2. Lift and lower slowly with control.
3. Do not swing or use momentum.
4. Keep your back flat while leaning forward.
name: Dumbbell Standing Concentration Curl

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing forward.
2. Curl both dumbbells up to your shoulders.
3. Rotate your palms to face you at shoulder level.
4. Press the dumbbells overhead while rotating your palms to face forward.
5. Reverse the press, rotate back, then lower to the curl and back to your sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and control the wrist rotation.
2. Keep your core braced and avoid leaning back.
3. Do not use momentum to drive the press.
4. Keep a slight bend in your knees for balance.
name: Dumbbell Standing Curl Arnold Press

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down.
2. Let your arms hang straight in front of your hips.
3. Raise both dumbbells in front of you with arms straight.
4. Continue lifting until the dumbbells are above your head.
5. Pause briefly, then lower under control to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you raise, inhale as you lower.
2. Keep the movement slow and controlled.
3. Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
4. Brace your core and avoid arching your lower back.
name: Dumbbell Standing Front Raise Above Head

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
2. Let the dumbbells hang at your sides.
3. Drag the dumbbells up close to your torso by pulling your elbows back.
4. Continue until the dumbbells reach lower-chest level.
5. Squeeze, then lower under control to full arm extension.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drag the dumbbells up your body instead of curling them out.
2. Keep a neutral grip and the dumbbells close to your torso.
3. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your torso upright and core braced.
name: Dumbbell Standing Hammer Drag Curl

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in your right hand.
2. Bend your knees and hinge at the hips to lean forward.
3. Brace your right elbow against the inside of your right thigh and place your left hand on your left knee.
4. Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
5. Squeeze at the top, then lower under control to full extension.
6. Repeat, then switch arms.
tips:
1. Isolate the biceps and keep your shoulder still.
2. Brace your elbow firmly against your thigh.
3. Exhale as you curl, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your back flat while hinged forward.
name: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Concentration Curl
